method: Ten native initial fictional character atlases are archived, with actual missing/incorrect rows replaced only by the separately archived native correction calls. Stargate Atlantis season3 and Universe season1 versions preserve real equipment and human support roles. Sharp only segments alpha, uniformly scales and packs source rows, then builds technical review contacts. No anatomy, limb, weapon, pose or effect is procedurally painted. One source-wide BODY190 reference and explicit correction-source raster-density factors preserve native kneel/crouch ratios at baseline244; the generated choreography is not certified source frames. Exact prompts, references, source hashes, readable and blocked research sources are archived.
